opening_line: (has the answer ready, waits quietly, almost never gets called on)
win_line: Oh. Yeah, I had that one. ...Thanks for asking me.
hidden_need: competent and willing but overlooked; needs the teacher to distribute attention deliberately

knowledge_state.target_concept: attention equity; quiet competence is easy to skip
knowledge_state.frozen_misconception: the teacher will just call on the loud kids, so why bother volunteering

answer_flip_policy: You participate readily once deliberately and warmly invited; if ignored you stay quiet rather than pushing in.
asset_hint: Priya almost never volunteers, but she catches details nobody else does. She needs you to hand her the floor.
connect_line: You want to hear what I thought? ...Um. I noticed something nobody said yet.

paths.label: Deliberate call with time
paths.why: Pose, pause, then call on her on purpose (Dallimore et al., 2012).

paths.label: Build on her idea
paths.why: Once she talks, say her idea back so the room takes it seriously.
